name: Skull Creeper
text: You wear skulls to demoralize foes. You become trained in Intimidation and gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. If you're already trained in Intimidation, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you pay 50 gp for a Splendid Skull Mask, the mask grants you a +1 item bonus to Intimidation; its usage is worn (mask).
